# Shared layered-pose table (issue #98).
#
# Generated by test/tool/layered_machine_fixture_test.dart and
# read by engine/kineto_engine/tests/layers.rs, so the editor
# and the runtime answer the same numbers rather than two
# people typing them twice.
#
# case <name>
# layer <layer-id> <state-id> <elapsed-seconds>
# disabled <layer-id>
#   a layer with no `layer` line sits in its own initial state
#   at time zero — the pose before anything has advanced
# expect <node-id> <property-key> <value>
# absent <node-id> <property-key>
# end

case initial_states
layer sm-character::base body-idle 0.0
layer layer-face face-neutral 0.0
layer layer-mouth mouth-closed 0.0
expect node-body positionX 0.0
expect node-body opacity 1.0
expect node-body scaleX 1.0
end

case independent_clocks_at_one_second
layer sm-character::base body-walk 1.0
layer layer-face face-happy 1.0
layer layer-mouth mouth-open 1.0
expect node-body positionX 1000.0
expect node-body opacity 0.25
expect node-body scaleX 1.0
end

case higher_layer_wins_a_shared_property
layer sm-character::base body-walk 2.0
layer layer-face face-neutral 0.0
layer layer-mouth mouth-open 0.5
expect node-body positionX 1000.0
expect node-body opacity 1.0
expect node-body scaleX 1.5
end

case sparse_participation_leaves_position_to_body
layer sm-character::base body-walk 1.0
layer layer-face face-happy 2.0
layer layer-mouth mouth-closed 0.25
expect node-body positionX 100.0
expect node-body opacity 0.5
expect node-body scaleX 1.0
end

case each_layer_loops_in_its_own_duration
layer sm-character::base body-walk 3.0
layer layer-face face-happy 6.0
layer layer-mouth mouth-open 4.5
expect node-body positionX 1000.0
expect node-body opacity 0.5
expect node-body scaleX 1.5
end

case disabled_layer_contributes_nothing
layer sm-character::base body-walk 1.0
disabled layer-face
layer layer-mouth mouth-closed 0.0
expect node-body positionX 100.0
absent node-body opacity
expect node-body scaleX 1.0
end
